critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1527 lines; the router-split refactor called out in iteration 4 is still pending. Adding /me/bank-account here is fine but continues the trend.

Withdrawal creation path resolves bank_code from the payload OR bound account, but on line 872 the fallback to bound only triggers when bank_name/account_number/account_name are ALL missing — mixed payloads (e.g. only amount + account_number) will silently drop the bound bank_name/account_name. Minor but worth documenting: consumers should send either fully explicit bank fields or none.

BindAccount.jsx debounced verify effect (line 99) fires only when bank_code or account_number changes. When a user re-visits the Edit page with existing bound details unchanged, no verify banner shows — a small UX gap (user gets no confirmation their existing binding is still valid). Consider firing once on mount when both fields are pre-populated.

BindAccount.jsx catch on verify (line 115) silently maps ALL errors (including 500/network) to 'unknown' with the same neutral copy — good UX but hides genuine outages from logs. Consider adding a console.warn.
